name: Operator Tools
description: Exposes the Operator capability adapters (Beeper messaging and friends) as agent tools, calling the on-device agent bridge over pinned loopback TLS.

bridgeUrl.description: Base URL of the agent bridge, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:9443. Loopback only.

tokenPath.description: Path to the bearer token file the phone runtime minted (never the token value itself).

certPath.description: Path to the runtime's exported TLS certificate PEM; the plugin pins this exact certificate.
